Provide the list of facilities covered in PCI scope: 

-  Facilities in PCI scope (with detailed Address) 
-  PCI related Business  
-  Cardholder Data payment channel (Card present  / Card Not Present)

If you are using payment application e.g.  (Payment switch) then provide below information

- Name of product 
- Version of product 
- Whether payment application has been validated according to PA-DSS
- PA-DSS reference number, if applicable
- P2PE reference number, if applicable
- Expiry date of PA-DSS validation, if applicable

Provide high level network diagram showing the overall architecture of the environment being assessed. The diagrams should identify all locations and key systems, and the boundaries between them. 
Ensure the diagram(s) includes the following: -    

All connections into and out of the network, including demarcation points between the cardholder data environment (CDE) and other networks/zones 
-    Connectivity type used for data transmission (IPSEC tunnel, SSL, SFTP etc.)
-    Internal, External and DMZ network zones  with cardholder application and database systems in respective network zone OR PCI scope specific VLAN’s (as well as their locations and the boundaries between them)
-    All network devices firewall, IPS, Router, VPN devices, Switches devices  as applicable
-    Third party connections having cardholder data shared with

Provide Inventory of  inscope servers (Windows, UNIX and Linux platform) / Network devices (Firewall, Routers, IPS/IDS, VPN, Core switch), database, data storage locations and software’s or applications used.                                                                                                                                                          Iventory should include Internal and external IP's, Total population, Manufacturer and model no.
Provide the list of externally accessible IP addresses  included in the ASV quarterly scan.

Provide Firewall, Router configuration, Azure Network Security Rules and any network change management sample reports (Recent 3 samples for each of firewall and router). 
Records should include following information at minimum:    
- Change approval    
- Change testing for firewall, router configuration    
- Change testing for network connections

Provide one or more detailed diagrams (including LAN, WAN or Internet) to illustrate each communication point. 
Diagrams should include the following: 
-    All boundaries of the cardholder data environment 
-    Any network segmentation points which are used to reduce scope of the assessment
-    Boundaries between trusted and un-trusted networks
-    Wireless (if available)  and wired networks 
-    All other connection points applicable to the assessment
-    Ensure the diagram(s) include enough detail to clearly understand how each communication point functions and is secured. (For example, the level of detail may include identifying the types of devices, device interfaces, network technologies, protocols, and security controls applicable to that communication point.)     Please include date and version number in all the Network Diagrams    Please clearly depict the PCI Scope Environment in the Diagram (Use dotted lines or Colour the area)     

Provide the details on Network zones / VLAN ID (from Firewall and L3 switch config) 

Please use terminology like CDE and Non-CDE or colour codes to depict the servers with and without card data within the PCI Scope Environment.

Provide cardholder data flow Diagrams (DFD) showing each processes  having cardholder data processing, transmission and storage -  
  
Identify all the systems involve in storage, processing and transmission of cardholder data  in DFD including the systems mentioned in cardholder data matrix  for storage of cardholder data-    Show in each step of dataflow what type of cardholder data (Name, PAN, CVV, PIN , Expiry date  etc.) transmitted, processed or stored (Note-  No storage of CVV, PIN allowed post authorization for any entity, except for Issuer with business justification)

Sample processes may include the cardholder data transmission, storage and processing as (if applicable)
for Banks:
1.    Debit and Credit card - Issuing,  
2.    ATM transaction acquiring and authorization, 
3.    POS transaction acquiring and authorization, 
4.    Online transaction acquiring and authorization, 
5.    Charge back and Claims Process, 
6.    Fraud Management Process, 
7.    Reconciliation and Settlement process, 
8.    Call Center support / IVR support Example 
for BPO:
1.    Data flow for Customer cardholder data transmission or processing at BPO environment 
2.    Data flow for Customer cardholder data received over various channels  i.e. telephone (call recording), fax, email etc.
Provide documented Role and responsibilities (Teams, Groups & personnel) related to firewall and router devices logical management Firewall and Router user access matrix:

Provide documentation and business justification for use of all services, protocols, and ports allowed on firewall and router, including documentation of security features implemented for those protocols considered to be insecure e.g. Telnet, FTP, SNMP, POP3, IMAP etc.
Provide Firewall and router rule set review reports for every six months (Two review reports for firewall and routers in case of re-certification)

Provide evidence of firewall used between wireless network and CDE as below (if applicable)

- Provide the VLAN ID / network interface for wireless network segment
- Provide access lists on firewall which shows the traffic between wireless network and CDE is specifically restricted or allowed as per business requirement

Provide List of sample of 5 users with laptops or any mobile devices that connect to the Internet when outside the network (for example, laptops used by employees), and which are also used to access the network

For such laptops, Provide the information on what personnel firewall software is configured on these laptops.    
- Provide screenshot of firewall running and active on laptops or any mobile device    
- Provide screenshot of access restriction showing firewall can not be disabled by device user

If Wireless access point is used in Cardholder Data Environment or for Card data transmission then provide device details of wireless access point (device name, model, firmware version, encryption used for transmission such as WEP or WPA2  etc.) if used in PCI scope environment  (if applicable) 

- Provide the screenshot for firmware version, encryption used for transmission such as WEP or WPA2      Provide wireless configuration document applied on wireless access point.

Provide Hardening (secure configuration) guideline documents for all types of system components (server, network device, application platform, database, wireless device in PCI certification scope) identified in point 3.

A) Provide details of any system running with insecure service such as telnet, ftp, HTTP (for sensitive data transmission or system administration) and business justification for no use of secure service such as SSH, SFTP or HTTPS instead.

B) Provide evidence for additional security features implemented for use of identified insecure services.

A) Provide Cardholder data (PAN, Cardholder Name, Expiry date) system storage locations and data retention period (consider the storage location as Databases, server logs or files, User systems, any media or backup tapes etc.)

B) Provide Cardholder data Data secure deletion process and data deletion records / logs as per retention period completion (If applicable)

Provide location details where the  sensitive authentication data -  CVV, PIN, Track is stored.
If any of this sensitive authentication data is stored then confirm data storage for issuers function with valid documented business justification

Provide sample of transaction / debug / trace / history  logs for applications / systems  involved in cardholder data processing and transmission (this is to check what cardholder data i.e. TRACK ,CVV, PIN getting recorded in logs)

A) Provide evidence for PCI scope applications screens and any records (hard copy or soft copy) showing full PAN and / or Masked PAN: 

B) Provide business justification for full PAN display

Provide data Encryption policy explaining encryption controls implemented for Cardholder data data secure storage (e.g. encryption, truncation, masking etc.)  – applicable for application, database and backup tapes    

A) Screenshots showing full PAN data is encrypted with strong encryption while stored (database tables or files) .  The captured details should also show the encryption algorithm and strength used .                                                                                                                                                      B) Provide the sample of audit logs showing PAN is rendered unreadable or remove from logs.                                                                                                                                                                                              C) For backup tapes, provide screenshot showing the encryption applied (algorithm and strength – e.g. AES 256 bit) through backup solution

If Disk encryption used for card data data, then is the logical access to encrypted file-system is separate from native operating system user access?  (Provide the adequate  evidences showing the logical access for local operating system and encrypted file system is with separate user authentication)

Additional requirement for service providers only:                                                                                 Provide a documented description of the cryptographic architecture that includes:
• Details of all algorithms, protocols, and keys used for the protection of cardholder data, including key strength and expiry date
• Description of the key usage for each key.
• Inventory of any HSMs and other SCDs used for key management

A) Provide list of users having access to the  Data Encryption Keys (DEK) and Key Encryption Keys (KEK)                                                                                                                                                               B) Provide Key custodian forms along with acknowledgement
Provide the evidence showing the exact locations where encryption keys are stored (keys should be stored at fewest possible locations)
Provide last key change record with date (in the event of / scenario of crypto period of key is over, integrity of the key has been weakened, known or suspected compromised keys)

In case of use of manual clear-text- keys, provide:    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                     A) List the users have split knowledge / dual control of encryption keys    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                     B) Custodian forms (undertaking of keys for secure handling by personnel in case of key distribution to personnel)

A) Provide details on Encryption technology used for cardholder data transmission over any open or public communication channel (i.e. Internet, Wireless network, GSM, GPRS, VSAT technology etc.)                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    B) provide the screenshot of encryption algorithm and key strength used at communication system or device end (e.g. web server, Router, Firewall).    
(Open communication may include the payment application access over web console, ATM connectivity over VSAT etc.)

C)Provide sample of payment or card data data transaction traffic logs showing cardholder data is transmitted with strong encryption

d) If Wireless network is used in Cardholder Data Environment or for Card data transmission then provide the screenshot for encryption algorithm used for authentication and transmission such as WEP or WPA2

Is cardholder data data sent over email, chat, messaging systems? If yes what level of encryption is applied for this data?  - provide the screenshot of encryption algorithm and key strength used for communication on user systems.

Provide Antivirus Server Management Console screenshot showing the antivirus signature update  and  systems scanning schedule configuration

- Signature update frequency
- Periodic scan frequency 
- Signature version
- Log storage for 3 months online and further 9 months offline
- Three summary scan run reports from the year

Provide Risk ranking process applied for new vulnerabilities. Recent internal vulnerability assessment reports showing risk ranking (e.g. High, Medium, Low)

Provide sample of recent security and patch release alerts for vendors or security groups from last 3 months

Provide evidence for using reputable outside sources for security vulnerability information
Provide Secure software development process document in accordance with PCI DSS, and based on industry best practices
Provide current list of users on payment application systems  (provide the users list screenshot)

Provide recent sample code review reports for PCI scope applications.  The sample should show how the PCI requirement 6.5.1 to 6.5.10 as listed below were followed during development: Injection flaws, Buffer overflow, Insecure cryptographic storage, Insecure communications, Improper error handling, High vulnerabilities, Cross-site scripting (XSS,) Improper Access Control Cross-site request forgery (CSRF) and Broken Authentication and Session Management
Provide IP subnet used  / VLAN ID details for development and production network to verify the network segregation)

Provide list of users with their designation for application developers , testers and  production application support team (as applicable)

Provide current list of users on payment application systems  (provide the users list screenshot)

Provide details on which cardholder data is used in application testing environment or in UAT?  How the PAN data for testing is generated (explain the process) ?
The process for removing test data and test accounts prior to moving the system to the higher (production) environment.

Provide recent sample change request for each of software modification and security patch deployment. The change request should include following details:
1. Change impact,
 2. Change approval, 
3. Change functionality testing to ensure the change does not adversely impact the security of the system 
4. Testing of all custom code updates for compliance with PCI DSS Requirement 6.5 (to address the vulnerabilities identified in 6.5.1 – 6.5.9)
 5. Change back-out procedures.

Provide recent secure development / coding techniques training records with attendees list

Provide 'Application secure coding guidelines'(which include guidelines for handling the security vulnerabilities as mentioned in PCI requirement 6.5.1 to 6.5.10 and updated current vulnerabilities as per industry best practices as per OWASP guide, SANS CWE Top 25, CERT secure coding etc.)

Provide Annual external web application vulnerability assessment report for public facing web applications. The reports should show clean results without any high vulnerability

Incase Web Application Firewall is used for protecting public facing web applications, then provide the web application model, firmware , signature version details and configuration screenshot showing attack filters are enabled to prevent from application vulnerabilities including PCI requirement 6.5.1 to 6.5.9

Provide PCI scope Application, server, network devices and database user access (permission) list  with business justification for each user - (No need to include the consumer user list for applications), for all sampled assets please provide below points
- List of users
- Access permission for those users
- Business justification for the level of access permission
Note:- 
1) Ensure all applications, OS and DB are in scope of evidence
2) Ensure for each that there are no generic ids being used. This would include looking at user lists and also logs to ensure no users logging in using generic ids

Provide recent sample User creation / access granting, deletion and access modification requests /  authorization forms for each category of application, network, server, database (as applicable)    
- Provide the sample authorization forms / requests for general users    
- Provide the sample authorization forms / requests for administrator users
Provide the sample user termination requests / forms from last six months and any evidence confirming their access was removed from all applicable systems immediately after user termination
Provide recent reports of user ID's are disabled or removed which are inactive for 90 days  for servers , network devices, applications, database.

Provide any sample user access request for vendor access (provided for system maintenance or support) with level of access provided to them as per business requirement

If vendors are provided remote access, then provide their activity monitoring reports

Provide Screenshots of  Servers (e.g. Windows, Unix, Linux, Mainframe server platform etc.), network devices (Firewall, Router, Core switch), database and applications in PCI certification scope, as applicable.
- Provide configuration setting screenshot for below points:

- Account lockout policy
- Account lockout duration
- Session timeout policy
- Password length
- Password complexity
- Password history
- Password expiry

Account lockout duration minimum - 30 min
Account lockout threshold maximum - 6 
Session timeout policy maximum - 15 min
Password length minimum - 7
Password complexity -enabled (numeric and alphabetic characters.)
Password history minimum - Last 4
Password expiry maximum - 90 days

- provide configuration screenshot showing encryption algorithm used and that stored passwords are unreadable at storage

If entity as service provider storing customer user passwords, provide the evidence for these password are stored encrypted using strong encryption     
- provide configuration screenshot showing encryption algorithm used and that stored passwords are unreadable at storage
Provide sample of recent password reset requests / forms users

Provide procedure details for all systems in PCI scope (domain system / server, network device, application, and database) on How unique password is allocated at the time of new user password creation and password reset request with user identity verification?

If any setting configured  to enforce the change of user password at first logon, provide the screenshot  for such setting

Description of technique for

- physical access allocation to the sensitive area is authorized and as per individual’s job function.

Provide Visitor access records (entry registers) for the facilities in PCI scope with retention period of 3 months

Visitor entry to PCI scope facility is authorized and visitor is escorted within facility

Provide up-to-date list of POS devices examined to verify it includes:
1. Make, model of device.
2. Location of device (for example, the address of the site or facility where the device is located).
3. Device serial number or other method of unique identification.

Provide training material and training record for personnel at point-of-sale locations to confirm that training included the following:

1. Verify the identity of any third-party persons claiming to be repair or maintenance personnel, prior to granting them access to modify or troubleshoot devices. 
2.  Do not install, replace, or return devices without verification.
3.  Be aware of suspicious behaviour around devices (for example, attempts by unknown persons to unplug or open devices). 
4.  Report suspicious behaviour and indications of device tampering or substitution to appropriate personnel (for example, to a manager or security officer).

3. Access to all audit trails.
4. All actions taken by any individual with root or administrative privileges.

6. All elevation of privileges.
7. All changes, additions, or deletions to any account with root or administrative privileges.
8. Initialization of audit logs.

Note:  Above sample audit logs should show information such as user ID, date & time,  type of event, success or failure indication of event, source and target system IP & hostname

Additional requirement for service providers only:                                                                     
Respond to failures of any critical security controls in a timely manner. Processes for responding to failures in security controls must include: 
• Restoring security functions 
• Identifying and documenting the duration (date and time start to end) of the security failure 
• Identifying and documenting cause(s) of failure, including root cause, and documenting remediation required to address root cause 
• Identifying and addressing any security issues that arose during the failure 
• Performing a risk assessment to determine whether further actions are required as a result of the security failure 
• Implementing controls to prevent cause of failure from reoccurring 
• Resuming monitoring of security controls

Provide sample of unauthorized (rouge) wireless access point logs / reports. Provide evidence that the incident management process is invoked in case of detection of rogue access points.
